[quote=oceanice_republic;59571351][b]The Ambush Attack[/b]

[i]Across the distance, a gunshot has been heard with a drone flying past. A Humvee carrying a group of SDS began to fire at the camp. 

Commander Aleksandr Claus communicates on the radio*
Strike Command Alpha, assume positions in the dunes. Chaos Delta, start the jamming operation. Show no mercy, they won't leave this desert alive. Signal jamming engaged. Enemy communications are down, replies a Chaos Delta Operative. 

Those in the Hydronia convoy remain unaware of the ambush. Sand shifts slightly as the snipers adjust their scopes, camouflaged in desert ghillie suits.  Strike Command Alpha, fire on my command... 3... 2... 1... Mark! Claus orders.

The stillness of the desert is shattered by the first sniper's shot, taking shots at camps.  Suppressing fire! Keep them pinned! orders the Strike Command Alpha leader.  The Alpha team rains bullets down, forcing Hydronia soldiers to duck for cover behind their vehicles. Meanwhile, one Alpha soldier maneuvers swiftly along the flank, planting explosives beneath one of the trucks. Push forward. Leave nothing standing, commands Claus.

Drones deployed by the Oceanice Republic received intelligence that a group of Hydronia forces was approaching the base housing weapons for Al-Qadi. The government dispatched 2 RQ-4 Global Hawks for reconnaissance. The drones confirmed Hydronia forces were on the move. Commander Aleksandr Claus of Special Delta Spears was informed and ordered Strike Command Alpha to execute a strike and eliminate the Hydronia team. Meanwhile, the Chaos Delta team began disrupting communications from the Hydronia forces.[/i][/quote]

[quote=united_hydronia;59571094]The Cobra Team follow Wurtalpa. Hayri sits down around the fire alongside the council members, whilst his men lean against the trees and other structures of the camp. Hayri shakes the council members hands as they are introduced.
[i]We will have to wait for confirmation from my government before we engage in any definite deals, but I wish to hear more of your people, a different perspective from the one known back in Hydronia.[/i][/quote]
Balunji então prepara sua voz, ele pega um copo de água ao seu lado e bebe, e então começa a contar a história, conforme ele vai falando, os outros presentes também vão adicionando mais.
[i]Ha muito tempo atrás, oque hoje é Alkiragunya era dividida em clãs, que não eram unidos como são hoje, era cada um por si, alguns tinham alianças, outros estavam por conta própria, no geral, podemos dizer que...éramos bem diferentes mas ainda... parecidos?
[/i]
Balunji faz uma pausa e gesticula para Ngarrajin continuar.
[i] E então , vocês vieram, ouvimos de comerciantes falando sobre "espíritos malignos vindos de terras distantes", e é claro, muitos pensaram que aquele seria o fim, não só de nosso povo, mas como do mundo....de nosso mundo.[/i]
Ngarrajin disse com a voz abafada pela própria bandana, ele toca no ombro de Dulbara com o indicador para que ele continue.
[i] Hm? Eu, bem acredito que vocês não estejam tendo uma visão muito aprofundada, mas não se preocupem, eu posso fazer isso! [/i]
Dulbara diz, ele põem a mão sobre o fogo , sua mão não queima, apenas uma parte fica em sua mão, a chama queima em formas que vão simulando tudo que foi dito até então.
[i]...e então foi aí que 12 líderes dos clãs mais poderosos se uniram em uma aliança, para não só proteger nossa terra, mas também nosso povo, nossos sonhos.[/i]
Balunji prossegue, mas Dulbara continua ilustrando com o fogo em suas mãos.
[i]Mas, não foram apenas 12 clãs, cada vez mais e mais se juntaram, eles juraram lealdade para os 12, assim surgiu Alkiragunya, originalmente feita para ser uma federação, e assim que a ameaça partisse,  retornariamos a nossa vida comum divididos, mas , então vimos como era essencial a unidade e decidimos manter.[/i]
Balunji diz, mas então Dulbara o repreende.
[i] Você esqueceu de mencionar o mais importante, além de orgulhoso quer apagar uma parte da história?[/i]
[i]olha quem fala...[/i]
Balunji murmura baixo para si mesmo, Dulbara prossegue, jogando a chama em sua mão na fogueira, e começa a manipular as chamas da própria fogueira, representando guerreiros Alkiragunyan.
[i]Guerreiros de dezenas de clãs, formaram caravanas gigantescas, que as moviam pelas areias de forma ágil, sabíamos que jamais venceriamos dos Gudjukari em confronto direto, mas , decidimos uma abordagem diferente, os ataques seriam rápidos e ferozes, por isso vocês talvez nos chamassem de brutais, já que fazíamos ataques rápidos, e os clãs que atacavam vocês, os Penguji, eram especialmente rápidos, seus ataques são muito conhecidos até hoje por serem precisos e fatais, meu clã, Dingu também teve um grande papel nessa parte, é claro...
Talvez a maior batalha que fizemos, e mais decisiva foi próxima de Towurunga, seus ancestrais chegaram perigosamente perto do centro de nossa confederação certa vez... chamamos aquela batalha de batalha dos 20 clãs, onde todos os clãs , pelo menos unidos na época, se juntaram para combater os invasores...tivemos que usar algo...além de lanças e boomerangs....
[/i]
Tjarrampa faz uma breve interrupção, ele levanta algumas pequenas pedras e as faz flutuar sobre suas mãos, Balunji abre a boca e retira de dentro a água que ele tinha engolido e a manipula como deseja, criando formas de serpente.
[i] Utilizamos magia [/i].
Balunji diz e gesticula para Dulbara prosseguir.
[i]E bem, digamos que os Gudjukaris desistiram, nunca viram nada parecido com aquilo que usávamos, chamaram de bruxaria ou algo do tipo e então nos deixaram quietos, não antes de nós mesmos roubarmos algumas de suas armas e criarmos nossas próprias.[/i]
Dulbara aponta para Ngarrajin que mostra um rifle artesanal por baixo de suas vestes grossas de tecido.
[i]E resumidamente, essa é a interação de seu povo com nós, desde então, acreditamos que vocês mudaram, e , certamente não queremos expulsar vocês com nossos poderes  novamente [/i].
Dulbara brinca de leve, enquanto para de manipular as chamas .
[Spoiler=translation]
[quote=united_hydronia;59571094]The Cobra Team follows Wurtalpa. Hayri sits down around the fire alongside the council members, whilst his men lean against the trees and other structures of the camp. Hayri shakes the council members hands as they are introduced.
[i]We will have to wait for confirmation from my government before we engage in any definite deals, but I wish to hear more of your people, a different perspective from the one known back in Hydronia.[/i][/quote]
Balunji then prepares his voice, he takes a glass of water from beside him and drinks, and then begins to tell the story, as he speaks, the others present also add more.
[i]A long time ago, what is now Alkiragunya was divided into clans, which were not united as they are today, it was every man for himself, some had alliances, others were on their own, overall, can we say that...we were very different but still...similar? [/i]
Balunji pauses and gestures for Ngarrajin to continue.
[i] And then, you came, we heard from traders talking about "evil spirits coming from distant lands", and of course, many thought that would be the end, not only of our people, but of the world... of our world.[/i]
Ngarrajin said with his voice muffled by his own bandana, he touches Dulbara's shoulder with his index finger for him to continue.
[i] Hm? I, well, believe that you are not having a very deep insight, but don't worry, I can do it![/i]
Dulbara says, he puts his hand over the fire, his hand does not burn, only a part remains in his hand, the flame burns in shapes that simulate everything that has been said so far.
[i]...and that's when 12 leaders of the most powerful clans came together in an alliance, to not only protect our land, but also our people, our dreams.[/i]
Balunji continues, but Dulbara continues illustrating with the fire in his hands.
[i]But, it wasn't just 12 clans, more and more joined, they swore loyalty to the 12, thus Alkiragunya was born, originally made to be a federation, and as soon as the threat was gone, we would return to our common life divided, but then we saw how essential unity was and we decided to maintain it.[/i]
Balunji says, but then Dulbara reprimands him. [i] You forgot to mention the most important thing, besides being proud, you want to erase a part of history?[/i]
[i]Look who's talking...[/i]
Balunji mutters quietly to himself, Dulbara continues, throwing the flame in his hand into the fire, and begins to manipulate the flames of the fire itself, representing Alkiragunyan warriors. [i]Warriors from dozens of clans formed gigantic caravans, which they moved through the sands in an agile manner. We knew that we would never win against the Gudjukari in a direct confrontation, but we decided on a different approach. The attacks would be fast and fierce. That's why you might call us brutal, since we made fast attacks, and the clans that attacked you, the Penguji, were especially fast. Their attacks are well-known to this day for being precise and fatal. My clan, Dingu, also played a major role in this part, of course...
Perhaps the biggest and most decisive battle we fought was near Towurunga. Your ancestors came dangerously close to the center of our confederation once... We called that battle the battle of the 20 clans, where all the clans, at least united at the time, came together to fight the invaders... We had to use something... besides spears and boomerangs....
[/i]
Tjarrampa makes a Briefly interrupted, he lifts some small stones and makes them float over his hands, Balunji opens his mouth and takes out the water he had swallowed and manipulates it as he wishes, creating snake shapes.
[i] We use magic [/i].
Balunji says and gestures for Dulbara to continue.
[i] And well, let's just say that the Gudjukaris gave up, they had never seen anything like what we used, they called it witchcraft or something like that and then left us alone, not before we ourselves stole some of their weapons and created our own.[/i]
Dulbara points to Ngarrajin who shows a homemade rifle under his thick cloth robes.
[i] And in short, this is the interaction of your people with us, since then, we believe that you have changed, and we certainly do not want to expel you with our powers again [/i].
Dulbara jokes lightly, as she stops manipulating the flames.
[/spoiler]

[quote=oceanice_republic;59550791][b][i]The Trade Deal[/i][/b]
